title: SeaTalk hardware
description: Pins and polarity for the SeaTalk 1 bus interface. -1 uses this firmware's default for the chip (ESP32: RX 32, TX 33; ESP32-S3: RX 13, TX 12, LED enable 11). Pins used by flash or PSRAM are refused and leave the bus stopped with a log message.

keys.name: rx_pin
keys.title: SeaTalk RX pin
keys.description: GPIO connected to the SeaTalk RX interface (-1 = chip default).

keys.name: tx_pin
keys.title: SeaTalk TX pin
keys.description: GPIO driving the SeaTalk TX interface (-1 = chip default). Avoid strapping, flash, and PSRAM pins.

keys.name: invert
keys.title: Invert RX and TX
keys.description: On for transistor/optocoupler interfaces that invert both lines.

keys.name: led_en_pin
keys.title: RX/TX lights enable pin
keys.description: GPIO enabling bus activity LEDs (-1 = chip default, -2 = disabled).

keys.name: led_act_hi
keys.title: Lights enable active high
keys.description: When on, driving the enable pin HIGH turns the RX/TX lights on.

keys.name: leds
keys.title: RX/TX lights
keys.description: Bus activity lights on or off (applies immediately when an enable pin is configured).
